prompts.prompt: Create a premium 3D editorial icon cutout for an English enterprise presentation. Single sculptural object, exceptionally polished chrome and translucent cobalt-blue glass, crisp icy-cyan edge light, one tiny warm amber detail, physically convincing reflections, sophisticated studio product rendering, not cartoon, not a flat app icon, not a rounded-square app tile. Three-quarter isometric view, object fills about 80% of a square canvas with comfortable clean margins. Genuinely transparent background with clean alpha, no ground plane, no drop-shadow rectangle, no text, no letters, no currency symbols, no logos, no watermark. Designed to read clearly at a medium size over a midnight-navy slide. Subject: an elegant open glass knowledge book cradled by a brushed-chrome magnifying-glass ring, with a few precise orbiting information beads. Symbolizes knowledge discovery and customer-support decision-making. Bold, immediately recognizable silhouette; few large parts rather than many tiny details.
